author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: ततः को दोष इत्यत उच्यते । अहं चेत्कर्म न कुर्यां तदा इमे लोकाः उत्सीदेयुः (नश्येयुः) कर्मलोपेन नरकं प्राप्नुयुः। किञ्च कर्मलोपे सति ब्रह्मक्षत्रादिवर्णविवेको न स्यात् । अतो वर्णसङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यां भवेयम् । एवमहमेव प्रजाः उपहन्यां हतवान् भवेयम् ॥ ३.२४॥
translation:
These worlds would perish, if I should not perform Karma; then I would be the author of confusion of castes, and I would be destroying these creatures. (24.) 
V. Parish: fall into misery and hell for omission of duty. Further, when duties are abandoned, the distinction between the castes would become effaced. Then the confusion of castes and the ruin of all beings should appear to proceed from Me. (24.) 
A. If the wise man also should perform duties with the same attachment as the ignorant, the action of both could not then differ.' This supposition is amended in the following.
